：合欢宗胆子不小（：合欢宗胆子不小（第22页）但我们合欢宗的弟子可没有对苍玄宗的人动过一根手指头。再说了，大家都是修真之人，只不过修炼的路数不同罢了，又不是什么不共戴天的世仇。”她顿了顿，端起茶杯抿了一口，润了润嗓子，然后接着说道，笑容愈发明媚：“如今何掌门突破元婴，这可是整个南华边区天大的喜事，普天同庆都来不及呢，我们合欢宗当然也要来沾沾喜气，恭贺一番。我兰若音亲自登门道贺，那是带着十足诚意的，还望少宗主大人大量，不要跟小女子一般见识呢。况且这次来，也是为了我们大家的利益”林枫不置可否地哼了一声，也没有继续追究的意思。合欢宗虽然名声不太好听，但也确实算不上苍玄宗的生死仇敌。他伸手示意了一下，语气不冷不热地说道：“行吧，既然来了就是客。有什么事直接和我说吧，师傅闭关期间，一切事务由我全权处置。”玉兰宫宫主苏梅见状，率先表明了自己的态度。她从容地站起身来，从袖中取出一只绣工精致的储物袋，双手捧着递上前来，语气诚恳而郑重：“这是我玉兰宫送给何掌门的一些贺礼，里面是我们玉兰宫最好的几位灵符师联手制作的上品灵符，聊表敬意。恭喜何掌门成为五大宗门中第一位元婴境前辈，同时，仙儿和少宗主的婚事也刚好确定下来。一旦有了名分以后，从今往后，我玉兰宫愿以苍玄宗马首是瞻，与贵宗同心同德，共进退。”林枫听到苏梅这番表态，忍不住乐了。玉兰宫是鹿仙儿的师门，苏梅又是鹿仙儿的师傅，没想到直接让他和鹿仙儿成婚。不但如此，还愿意屈尊在苍玄宗之下。这份眼力和决断力确实厉害，林枫估计谁厉害和谁联姻，之前是青木宗的掌门孙子，现在换成了林枫。他忍不住感叹道，“识时务者为俊杰。苏宫主，难怪你们玉兰宫在南华边区能屹立这么多年，代代昌盛不衰，果然是有原因的”听到林枫这么说，苏梅微微颔首。随即她再次开口说道：“既然林道友已经是苍玄宗的少宗主，而且苍玄宗由你说了算，那么与仙儿的婚姻，林道友便能自行决定了。”说完这话，苏梅一脸期待地望着林枫。如果说之前她对林枫还有一丝犹豫，那么现在苏梅对林枫那是一万个满意。不但有个元婴境的师傅，还是苍玄宗的少宗主，更别提这小子天赋异禀，如今已经是金丹境的修为了。未来前途不可限量，简直就是打着灯笼都难找的金龟婿。只要抱紧了林枫这条大粗腿，那她俞兰宫便可再次享数百年太平，再也不用看别人脸色过日子了。毕竟，玉兰宫太弱了，必须依靠联姻保住地位。林枫听了这话，面上不动声色，心里却开始盘算起来。自己日后肯定要前往南华郡，几个女人带在身边肯定不方便，打打杀杀的，哪还顾得上她们。

Chapter 670 The Hehuan Sect is very courageous (page 1)
: Hehuan Sect is not cowardly (: Hehuan Sect is not cowardly (page 22)) But we, the disciples of Hehuan Sect, have never laid a finger on anyone from Cangxuan Sect. Besides, we are all cultivators, but we have different paths of cultivation, and it is not some sworn feud." She paused, took a sip from the tea cup, moistened her throat, and then continued, her smile getting brighter: "Now Headmaster He suddenly suddenly Po Yuanying, this is a great joy for the entire Nanhua Border Region, and it is too late for the whole world to celebrate. Of course, we, the Hehuan Sect, have to come to share the joy and congratulate us. I, Lan Ruoyin, come to congratulate me in person, and I do so with full sincerity. I hope that the young sect leader will not be like a little girl. Besides, this time, it is for the benefit of all of us." Lin Feng snorted noncommittally and did not continue to pursue it. Meaning. Although the Hehuan Sect has a bad reputation, it is indeed not a life-and-death enemy of the Cangxuan Sect. He stretched out his hand and said in a lukewarm tone: "Okay, since you are here, you are a guest. If you have any questions, tell me directly. During the master's retreat, I have full authority to handle all matters." Seeing this, Su Mei, the master of the Yulan Palace, took the lead in expressing her attitude. She stood up calmly and took out an embroidered flower from her sleeve. Holding the exquisitely crafted storage bag, he handed it forward with both hands, and said in a sincere and solemn tone: "These are some congratulatory gifts from our Magnolia Palace to Master He. Inside are top-grade spiritual talismans jointly made by the best spiritual talisman masters of our Yulan Palace. Congratulations to Master He for becoming the first Nascent Soul Realm senior among the five major sects. At the same time, the marriage of Xian'er and the young sect leader has just been confirmed. Once the status is established, from now on, I will Magnolia Palace is willing to follow Cangxuan Sect's lead and work together with Guizong to advance and retreat together." Lin Feng couldn't help but be happy when he heard Su Mei's statement. Magnolia Palace is Lu Xian'er's disciple, and Su Mei is Lu Xian'er's master. I didn't expect him to marry Lu Xian'er directly. Not only that, but he was also willing to condescend to Cangxuan Sect. His vision and decision-making ability were indeed powerful. Lin Feng estimated that whoever was more powerful would marry whom. He was the head of Qingmu Sect before. The grandson is now Lin Feng. He couldn't help but sigh, "Those who know the current affairs are heroes. Palace Master Su, no wonder your Magnolia Palace has been able to stand in Nanhua Border District for so many years and has been prosperous from generation to generation. There is indeed a reason." Hearing what Lin Feng said, Su Mei nodded slightly. Then she spoke again: "Since Lin Daoyou is already the young master of Cangxuan Sect, and Cangxuan Sect is in your hands, then Lin's marriage to Xian'er Fellow Taoist can then make his own decision." After saying this, Su Mei looked at Lin Feng expectantly. If she was still a little hesitant about Lin Feng before, now Su Mei is extremely satisfied with Lin Feng. Not only does he have a master at the Nascent Soul Realm, but he is also the young master of the Cangxuan Sect, not to mention that this kid is extremely talented and has now reached the Golden Core Realm. His future prospects are limitless, and he is like a golden turtle husband who is hard to find even with a lantern. As long as she hugs Lin Feng's thick legs, Yulan Palace can enjoy peace for hundreds of years and no longer have to live at the mercy of others. After all, Yulan Palace is too weak and must rely on marriage to maintain its status. After hearing this, Lin Feng's face remained calm, but he began to make calculations in his heart. It would be inconvenient for him to have several women with him, and he would not care about them.
